\documentclass[paper={a5paper},maintitle={Key Spelling Probes}]{ulsbs-songbook}
\makeatletter
\newcount\ULtestoffset
\newcommand\ULtestprobe[2]{%
  \begingroup
  % Match the visual pipeline: this input is already source-transposed.
  \UL@pdfalternatetrue
  \UL@pdfspellprepare{\the\ULtestoffset}%
  \SB@dotranspose{#2}%
  \def\shrp{SHARP}\def\flt{FLAT}%
  \edef\ULtestresult{\the\SB@toks}%
  \typeout{ULSPELL:\ULtestcase:\the\ULtestoffset:#1:\ULtestresult}%
  \endgroup}
\newcommand\ULtestprobes[1]{%
  \def\ULtestcase{#1}%
  \edef\ULtestbefore{\the\SB@transposefactor,%
    \ifSB@prefshrps sharp\else flat\fi,%
    \ifSB@needkey auto\else fixed\fi}%
  \ULtestoffset=1
  \loop
    \ULtestprobe{C}{C}\ULtestprobe{Cs}{C\shrp}\ULtestprobe{Cf}{C\flt}%
    \ULtestprobe{D}{D}\ULtestprobe{Ds}{D\shrp}\ULtestprobe{Df}{D\flt}%
    \ULtestprobe{E}{E}\ULtestprobe{Es}{E\shrp}\ULtestprobe{Ef}{E\flt}%
    \ULtestprobe{F}{F}\ULtestprobe{Fs}{F\shrp}\ULtestprobe{Ff}{F\flt}%
    \ULtestprobe{G}{G}\ULtestprobe{Gs}{G\shrp}\ULtestprobe{Gf}{G\flt}%
    \ULtestprobe{A}{A}\ULtestprobe{As}{A\shrp}\ULtestprobe{Af}{A\flt}%
    \ULtestprobe{B}{B}\ULtestprobe{Bs}{B\shrp}\ULtestprobe{Bf}{B\flt}%
    \ULtestprobe{slash}{Fmaj7/G\shrp}%
    \ULtestprobe{suffix}{G\shrp m7(add9)/F\shrp}%
    \advance\ULtestoffset by 1
  \ifnum\ULtestoffset<12\repeat
  \edef\ULtestafter{\the\SB@transposefactor,%
    \ifSB@prefshrps sharp\else flat\fi,%
    \ifSB@needkey auto\else fixed\fi}%
  \ifx\ULtestbefore\ULtestafter\else
    \PackageError{key-spelling-probes}{Alternative spelling leaked source state}{}%
  \fi
  \typeout{ULSTATE:#1:\ULtestafter}}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\begin{songs}{}
\beginsong{C Major Probes}[id={fixture-1},key={C}]
\ULtestprobes{C}
{\preferflats\ULtestprobes{Cflats}}
{\prefersharps\ULtestprobes{Csharps}}
\beginverse \[C]Probe \endverse
\endsong
\beginsong{G Major Probes}[id={fixture-2},key={G}]
\ULtestprobes{G}\beginverse \[G]Probe \endverse
\endsong
\beginsong{A Minor Probes}[id={fixture-3},key={Am}]
\ULtestprobes{Am}\beginverse \[Am]Probe \endverse
\endsong
\beginsong{Sharp Major Probes}[id={fixture-4},key={F#}]
\ULtestprobes{Fs}\beginverse \[F#]Probe \endverse
\endsong
\beginsong{Sharp Minor Probes}[id={fixture-5},key={D#m}]
\ULtestprobes{Dsm}\beginverse \[D#m]Probe \endverse
\endsong
\beginsong{Flat Major Probes}[id={fixture-6},key={D&}]
\ULtestprobes{Df}\beginverse \[D&]Probe \endverse
\endsong
\beginsong{Flat Minor Probes}[id={fixture-7},key={B&m}]
\ULtestprobes{Bfm}\beginverse \[B&m]Probe \endverse
\endsong
\beginsong{Effective Key Probes}[id={fixture-8},key={D}]
\transpose{2}
\ULtestprobes{effectiveD}\beginverse \[C]Probe \endverse
\endsong
\end{songs}
\end{document}
